identity.name: Elara Thorne
identity.backstory: Elara grew up in a remote temple devoted to the goddess of mercy, training rigorously to become a healer for the afflicted. When bandits razed her village, she survived and vowed to protect the innocent with her divine magic and mace. Now she seeks companions strong enough to stand against evil.

identity.name: Thrain Stonebreaker
identity.backstory: Thrain grew up in the mountain clans of the Ironspine Peaks, honing his skills as a warrior defending against goblin raids. After his clan's forge was destroyed, he wanders the lands seeking glory and a chance to rebuild his legacy. He joins adventuring parties to test his mettle against greater foes.

identity.name: Silas Shadowstep
identity.backstory: Silas grew up navigating the treacherous slums of Waterdeep as an urchin, mastering the art of stealth and thievery to survive. A narrow escape from the city watch after a daring burglary convinced him to seek fortune on the open road with trustworthy companions. He now offers his nimble fingers and shadowy skills to any party in need of a subtle touch.

identity.name: Elowen Fireheart
identity.backstory: Elowen was raised in the secluded libraries of the elven enclave of Sylvandar, where she devoured ancient tomes of arcane lore from a young age. A prophetic dream of encroaching darkness compelled her to venture into the wider world, seeking allies to avert the foretold calamity. Though her spells crackle with raw power, her scholarly demeanor hides a fierce determination to master the Weave.

identity.name: Finnigan Quickfingers
identity.backstory: Born in the lively taverns of a bustling halfling village, Finnigan honed his skills as a performer, weaving tales and spells through song to delight crowds and lighten purses. After a botched heist left him fleeing from shady guildmasters, he sought redemption and glory by joining heroic adventurers. His melodies now bolster allies' courage while his cunning tricks unravel enemies' plans.
